# nginxproxymanager_access_list

**`item` blocks cannot be imported, as the password is not exported from the Nginx Proxy Manager API.**

Therefore, when importing the resource, all `item` blocks must be recreated.

## Example Usage 

```terraform
resource "nginxproxymanager_access_list" "example" {
  name = "test12345"

  item {
    username = "BasicAuthUser"
    password = "S3cur3P455w0rd!"
  }
  client {
    address   = "1.2.3.4"
    directive = "deny"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the access list.

### Optional

- `client` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--client))
- `item` (Block Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--item))
- `pass_auth` (Boolean) Whether the to pass auth to the host.
- `satisfy_any` (Boolean) Whether a request should pass if it satisfies any of the rules.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the access list.
- `owner_user_id` (Number) ID of the user which owns the access list.

<a id="nestedblock--client"></a>
### Nested Schema for `client`

Required:

- `address` (String) IP Address of a client.
- `directive` (String) Directive, allow or deny.


<a id="nestedblock--item"></a>
### Nested Schema for `item`

Required:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Basic auth password. NPM doesn't return passwords, so a password changed outside Terraform isn't detected.
- `username` (String) Basic auth username.

```terraform
# Import by the ID shown in the NPM UI or API
terraform import nginxproxymanager_access_list.example 1
```
